name: Hail surviving to surface
description: Direct HRRR column hail diameter, paired with melting-environment checks so the field flags cells where hail is both forming aloft AND likely to reach the ground at severe (≥ 1 inch) size. WFO Louisville tip sheet (Melting issues): freezing/wet-bulb-zero level < 10500 ft (~3200 m), limited warm-cloud depth (LCL → 0 °C). Companion to `large_hail` (which is environmental). Starting point — tune across cycles.
